result.title: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies
result.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Equal contribution: Qixuan Wu and Xiaole Yang. Corresponding authors: Yuguang Yang and Baochang Zhang
result.summary: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出轻量框架 FAVR，为冻结的 VLA 策略做视觉条件适配：用线性 test-time training 维护紧凑时序视觉状态，在 flow 式动作生成的各步检索 action 条件视觉特征，并把通道门控写成盒约束优化以提升机器人操作成功率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按生成步筛选并注入视觉特征、并分析注入特征如何影响预测速度」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与逐步贡献分配提供可核查线索；但工作属机器人策略工程，与推理机制的关联需自行判断。
